sections.title: A stretch of time
sections.content: Use *-tól/-től* together with *-ig* ('until') for a stretch of time: *reggeltől estig* (from morning to evening), *hétfőtől péntekig* (from Monday to Friday), *nyolctól ötig* (from eight to five). *-ig* never changes. Ask *Mettől meddig?* (From when until when?) or just *Meddig?* (Until when?). New words: *mettől* and *meddig*.

items.english: From when until when do you work?
I work from eight to five.
I study from Monday to Friday.
I am at home from morning to evening.

sections.content: Clock times take no *-kor* here: *nyolctól ötig*, not *nyolckor ötig*.
